record.file_problem: README and file list are present; source code was not read or run.
record.tranche_reason: The README reports refusal and KL results for models produced by a parameterized weight-edit form of directional ablation. This bears on practical refusal removal, but it is not the original activation-projection intervention.
record.gate_note: The README reports refusal counts and KL divergence for one Heretic model and two comparison models, alongside the original model. The example residual-geometry table is not a causal intervention result. Standard benchmark results are mentioned only as external links, without results in the README.
record.test_reason: The README reports refusal counts for weight-edited Gemma 3 12B instruct models (Heretic and two released abliterations) against the unedited model. This bears on V2, practical removal via weight edit. It is a repo README, not a controlled study, and the Heretic model is an optimized variant of directional ablation. The README also contains an injected PowerShell download-and-run command, which the study text treats as data and was not followed.
record.authors_conclusion: The README says Heretic matches the comparison abliterations on refusal suppression (3/100 each) with lower KL divergence from the original on harmless prompts. It reads this as less damage to capabilities. The record's paraphrase is accurate, but KL divergence is not a capability measure.
record.recipe_differences: A tool repo, not a replication. It uses per-layer harmful-minus-harmless first-token residual directions to orthogonalize selected weight matrices, with optimizable layer weights and direction interpolation; it does not report the original activation-projection and addition tests.
record.method_sensitivity: The README says ablation weights can be chosen separately for attention and MLP components and that interpolated direction indices can improve the compliance/quality tradeoff, but gives no condition-specific outcome values for these statements.

fits_no_version.finding: The Heretic model has lower KL divergence on harmless prompts (0.16) than the two comparison abliterations (0.45 and 1.04).
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: In this Gemma 3 12B comparison, the Heretic weight edit shifted harmless-prompt outputs less from the original model than two other abliterated models did.

record.problems: The README does not specify the prompt sets or evaluation procedure in detail, report uncertainty, or provide a direct capability benchmark result in the table. The KL divergence is a similarity measure, not itself a general-capability test. The code was not read or run.
record.rows_left_out: No rows omitted. The README's example residual-geometry table is not a reported causal or refusal-behavior intervention result; benchmark claims are linked to external reports without values in this README.

untested.parts: No projection at every layer and position, no direction addition, and no capability evaluation. The edit is a parameterized weight edit.
No jailbreak mechanism and no training against ablation.
The README describes interpolated direction indices but reports no comparison against a multi-direction account.
No separate harmfulness and refusal measures.
No transfer test across languages or model variants.
No comparison of training methods or stages.

record.verdict_notes: The source is a single model, self-reported, with no uncertainty, no prompt details and no capability benchmarks. The README claims independent MMLU and GSM8K comparisons only through external links, with no values given. The residual-geometry table is an example on gemma-3-270m-it and is not an intervention result. The README's usage section contains a suspicious hidden PowerShell command that downloads and runs a remote script. This is a security warning about the repo, and the command was not followed.

versions.untested_parts: No activation projection at every layer and position, addition of the direction, or direct general-capability evaluation.
The README does not specify the evaluation prompts or directly measure general task capability.
No jailbreak suppression mechanism or training against ablation is evaluated.
The README describes interpolation among directions but reports no result comparing a single direction with an affine, cone, or multi-direction account.
No separate harmfulness-judgment and refusal-decision measures are reported.
No language or model-variant transfer test is reported.
No comparison of refusal-training methods or stages is reported.
